entries.title: Fork pull request lacks signing secret
entries.root_cause: The workflow maps WILLOW_SIGNING_KEY from a secret and requires it on fork pull requests, where the value is empty. Avoid requiring the secret on untrusted fork runs.

entries.title: Policy file missing
entries.root_cause: The policy check cannot open config/policies/release.yaml because that path does not exist in the checkout. Supply the policy at that path or correct the workflow path.

entries.title: Signing variable misspelled
entries.root_cause: The workflow sets WILLOW_SIGNING_KE instead of WILLOW_SIGNING_KEY on a trusted branch run. Correct the environment variable name.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same empty-variable error occurs on a trusted push because the environment key is misspelled, not because fork secrets are unavailable.

entries.title: Fork signing secret absent again
entries.root_cause: The workflow maps WILLOW_SIGNING_KEY from a secret and requires it on fork pull requests, where the value is empty. Avoid requiring the secret on untrusted fork runs.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later fork pull request reaches the signing command through the Makefile on a different runner and Go patch version.
